lines.text: الجلوس ثم الوقوف من الكرسي. قم من الكرسي دون استخدام يديك، ثم اجلس ببطء. 3 × 10، كل يوم. استرح قليلاً بين المجموعات.
lines.source_en: Sit-to-stand from a chair. Stand up from a chair without using your hands, then sit down slowly. 3 × 10, every day. Rest a little between the sets.
lines.back_translation: Sitting then standing from the chair. Get up from the chair without using your hands, then sit slowly. 3 × 10, every day. Rest a little between the groups.

lines.text: تقويم الركبة جالسًا مع شريط (اليمين). اجلس على كرسي والشريط حول الكاحل وقم بتقويم الركبة ببطء. 3 × 12، كل يومين. زفر الهواء عند تقويم الركبة. لا تمسك أنفاسك.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (right). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every other day. Breathe out as you straighten the knee. Don't hold your breath.
lines.back_translation: Straightening the knee while sitting with a band (right). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every two days. Exhale the air when straightening the knee. Do not hold your breath.

lines.text: الخطوة للأعلى (اليمين). اخطُ للأعلى على الدرجة السفلى مع تقديم ساقك اليمنى، ثم انزل. 2 × 10، كل يوم. امسك درابزين الدرج دائمًا عند القيام بذلك.
lines.source_en: Step-up (right). Step up onto the bottom stair leading with your right leg, then step down. 2 × 10, every day. Always hold the stair rail when you do it.
lines.back_translation: Step up (right). Step up onto the lower step with your right leg forward, then step down. 2 × 10, every day. Always hold the staircase railing when doing this.

lines.text: المشي. امشِ بسرعة مريحة. 20 دقيقة، 5 أيام في الأسبوع. بعض ألم الركض أثناء المشي مقبول، طالما أنه يختفي بحلول الصباح التالي.
lines.source_en: Walking. Walk at a comfortable pace. 20 minutes, 5 days a week. Some knee pain while walking is acceptable, as long as it has settled by the next morning.
lines.back_translation: Walking. Walk at a comfortable speed. 20 minutes, 5 days in the week. Some pain of the knee while walking is acceptable, as long as it disappears by the next morning.

lines.text: تمدد الساق الخلفي ضد الحائط (اليمين). انحنِ ضد الحائط مع ساقك اليمنى خلفك، كعبك على الأرض، وامسك. 3 مرات، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Calf stretch against a wall (right). Lean against a wall with your right leg behind you, heel down, and hold. 3 times, every day.
lines.back_translation: Stretching the back of the leg against the wall (right). Lean against the wall with your right leg behind you, your heel on the ground, and hold.
